declared difference (truth fix T5, truth-equal-value-skip-1): Baja skips a write of an equal simple value
(ComplexSlotMap.java:1239 setDouble, :860 setBoolean, :637 set), so a constant written to a simple-typed slot is
not a per-cycle persisted write and does not qualify a hot changed() (truth-fresh-* keep the shapes).
declared difference (truth fix T1, truth-code-view-1): C2's commented-out changed(Property q ...) is no
longer the callback, so the real one (line 5) WARNs; C3's "}" in a string no longer ends changed() early (line 3 WARNs).
